Suctioned_Cephalopod_Tentacles.description: These tentacles, akin to an octopus's, pulsate with a mesmerizing rhythm underwater, their suction cups clinging effortlessly to surfaces as they propel you swiftly through aquatic realms. Their bioluminescent glow adds an eerie allure to your journey, blending seamlessly into the ocean's embrace.

Necrotic_Shadow_Tendrils.description: Necrotic Shadow Tendrils, ethereal wisps of corrupted magic that glide silently through the shadows, strike fear into hearts and chill bones with their ghostly touch, moving at an otherworldly speed.

Venomous_Stinging_Tendrils.description: The Venomous Stinging Tendrils unfurl from an ethereal jellyfish-like creature, their translucent tendrils pulsating with a mesmerizing bioluminescence. Each tendril is tipped with hollow spines that inject paralyzing venom and ensnaring coils, slowing any who dare to venture too close.
